docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,200.00 FILED BY INTEGRATED CLEANING SOLUTIONS AS TO DEFENDANT THE JUNGLE (ATT/MARK BLANKCARTE OWNER) ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-03-1997 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT C
